dslRule:
<!id: add-null-check-before-attribute-access>
<!description: Add null check before calling getAttribute on an IProcess object if not already present.>
<!severity: WARNING>

if ($proc.getAttribute($attr) != null) :: instanceof($proc, "org.eclipse.debug.core.model.IProcess")
=>
if ($proc != null && $proc.getAttribute($attr) != null)
;;
summary: Adds a null check for an IProcess object before accessing its 'getAttribute' method within an 'if' condition, when the null check is missing.
